guide.summary: Both mean 'two'. 两 answers 'how many?': it stands in front of a measure word or a unit (两个人, 两天, 两点). 二 is the number itself: counting, digits, ordinals, dates, and every 二 inside a bigger number (十二, 二十). If you could put 'second' or read the figure out as a digit, use 二; if you are counting things, use 两.

subs.label: 两 + measure word
subs.focus: A plain quantity of two before a measure word or money/weight unit: 两个, 两本, 两位, 两次, 两块钱, 两杯, 两张. The learner must choose 两 over 二 (classic error: 二个人, 二本书). Distractors: 二, 俩, 第二. Do not use the old weight unit 两 (二两) or 二位 as a polite address, where 二 is normal.

subs.label: 两 for clock time and durations
subs.focus: 两点 (two o'clock), 两点半, 两分钟, 两天, 两年, 两个小时, 两个星期, 两个月. The learner must choose 两 for the hour and for any amount of time (classic errors: 二点, 二天, 二年, 二个月). Include 十二点 and 两点二十 as traps where only the bare hour 'two' is 两.

subs.label: 二 for ordinals, dates and labels
subs.focus: 第二, 二月, 二号, 星期二, 二楼, 二年级, 二哥: a position in a series, not an amount. The learner must choose 二 (classic errors: 第两, 两月, 两号, 两楼). Best items contrast a label with a quantity in a context that forces one reading: 二月 / 两个月, 第二天 / 两天, 第二次 / 两次, 二楼 / 两层楼, 二年级 / 两年.

subs.label: 二 for counting, digits and maths
subs.focus: Counting aloud (一二三), reading out digits (room, bus, phone and year numbers), sums (一加一等于二), decimals (零点二) and fractions (二分之一, 三分之二). No measure word follows, so the learner must choose 二 (classic error: 零点两, 两分之一, 一加一等于两).

subs.label: 二 inside 十二, 二十, 二十二
subs.focus: In the tens and units places 二 never changes, even when a measure word follows: 十二个, 二十个, 二十二岁, 三十二块. The learner sees a measure word and wrongly reaches for 两 (classic errors: 十两个, 两十个, 两十两). Blank either the 二 before 十 or the 二 after 十; distractor is always 两.

subs.label: Two before 百, 千, 万, 亿
subs.focus: Leading 'two' in big numbers: 两千, 两万, 两亿 are the normal spoken forms, but 二千, 二万 and 二百 / 两百 are also correct, so never offer 二 and 两 as rival options there (use 俩, 双, 第二 as distractors). Force a choice only next to 十: 二十万, 十二万. Judge items may mark only 两十万 or 十两万 wrong.

subs.label: 两 = a couple, a few
subs.focus: 两 as a loose 'a couple of': 过两天, 这两天, 说两句, 吃两口, 等两分钟. The English cue says 'a couple of / a few' and the learner must still pick 两, not 二 and not 几个 forms that break the sentence (classic error: 过二天). Make the vague reading clear in the English.

subs.label: 俩 = 两个
subs.focus: 俩 already contains the measure word: 我们俩, 他们俩, 你们俩, 俩人, 俩孩子. The learner must decide between 俩 and 两 depending on whether 个 follows (classic errors: 俩个, 我们两 with nothing after it, 俩本书). Options should include 俩, 两, 二 and the sentence must show whether 个 is already there.

rules.rule: Counting two of something: 两 + measure word. Never 二 directly before a measure word.

examples.py: wǒ yǒu liǎng ge dì di
examples.en: I have two younger brothers.

examples.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu liǎng běn shū
examples.en: There are two books on the table.

examples.py: zhè ge miàn bāo liǎng kuài qián
examples.en: This bread costs two kuai.

examples.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì běi jīng
examples.en: I have been to Beijing twice.

rules.note: With traditional and metric units (斤, 米, 公里) you will also hear 二, and the polite 二位 exists next to 两位. 两 is never wrong in these, so use 两.

rules.rule: Two o'clock is 两点, and any length of time uses 两: 两天, 两年, 两分钟, 两个小时, 两个月.
rules.pattern: 两 + 点 / 分钟 / 天 / 年;  两 + 个 + 小时 / 星期 / 月

examples.py: xiàn zài liǎng diǎn bàn
examples.en: It's half past two now.

examples.py: wǒ xué le liǎng nián hàn yǔ
examples.en: I have studied Chinese for two years.

examples.py: tā zài shàng hǎi zhù le liǎng ge yuè
examples.en: He lived in Shanghai for two months.

examples.py: wǒ men liǎng diǎn èr shí jiàn miàn
examples.en: Let's meet at two twenty.

rules.note: Only the bare hour 'two' is 两点. Twelve o'clock is 十二点, and the minutes follow the normal number rules (二十分, 零二分).

rules.rule: A position in a series takes 二: 第二, months, days of the month, weekdays, floors, school years.
rules.pattern: 第 + 二 + measure word;  二 + 月 / 号 / 楼 / 年级;  星期 + 二

examples.py: jīn tiān shì èr yuè èr hào
examples.en: Today is the second of February.

examples.py: zhè shì wǒ dì èr cì lái zhōng guó
examples.en: This is my second time in China.

examples.py: wǒ jiā zài èr lóu
examples.en: My home is on the second floor.

examples.py: xīng qī èr xià wǔ wǒ yǒu kè
examples.en: I have class on Tuesday afternoon.

rules.rule: Label or amount? The same noun takes 二 when it names which one and 两 when it says how many.
rules.pattern: 二月 (February) / 两个月 (two months);  第二天 (the next day) / 两天 (two days)

examples.zh: 我二月去北京，住两个月。
examples.py: wǒ èr yuè qù běi jīng zhù liǎng ge yuè
examples.en: I'm going to Beijing in February and staying two months.

examples.py: dì èr tiān tā jiù huí jiā le
examples.en: He went home the very next day.

examples.zh: 我妹妹上二年级，学了两年英语。
examples.py: wǒ mèi mei shàng èr nián jí xué le liǎng nián yīng yǔ
examples.en: My younger sister is in second grade and has studied English for two years.

rules.rule: The number on its own is 二: counting, reading digits one by one, sums, decimals and fractions.
rules.pattern: 零 + 点 + 二;  二 + 分之 + 一;  digit + digit + 二

examples.py: yī jiā yī děng yú èr
examples.en: One plus one equals two.

examples.py: wǒ de fáng jiān hào shì sān líng èr
examples.en: My room number is 302.

examples.py: èr fēn zhī yī jiù shì yī bàn
examples.en: One over two is just a half.

examples.zh: 他的成绩比我高零点二分。
examples.py: tā de chéng jì bǐ wǒ gāo líng diǎn èr fēn
examples.en: His score is 0.2 points higher than mine.

rules.rule: Next to 十, two is always 二, even when a measure word follows. 两 only replaces a single-digit 2.
rules.pattern: 十二 / 二十 / 二十二 + measure word + noun

examples.py: wǒ men bān yǒu shí èr ge xué sheng
examples.en: There are twelve students in our class.

examples.py: tā jīn nián èr shí suì
examples.en: He is twenty this year.

examples.py: zhè jiàn yī fu èr shí èr kuài qián
examples.en: This piece of clothing costs twenty-two kuai.

examples.zh: 教室里有三十二把椅子。
examples.py: jiào shì lǐ yǒu sān shí èr bǎ yǐ zi
examples.en: There are thirty-two chairs in the classroom.

rules.rule: At the front of a big number say 两千, 两万, 两亿. Before 百 both 二百 and 两百 are fine. Any 二 next to 十 stays 二: 二十万, 十二万.
rules.pattern: 两 + 千 / 万 / 亿;  二 or 两 + 百;  二十 + 万

examples.py: zhè ge shǒu jī liǎng qiān kuài
examples.en: This phone costs two thousand kuai.

examples.zh: 我们学校有两万多个学生。
examples.py: wǒ men xué xiào yǒu liǎng wàn duō ge xué sheng
examples.en: Our school has more than twenty thousand students.

examples.py: nà liàng chē èr shí wàn
examples.en: That car costs two hundred thousand.

examples.py: zhè běn shū yǒu liǎng bǎi duō yè
examples.en: This book has over two hundred pages.

rules.note: 二千 and 二万 are not wrong (they are common in writing and when reading out figures), and in the middle of a number both 两千二百 and 两千两百 are heard. 两千 and 两万 are the safe spoken choice.

rules.rule: 两 also means 'a couple of, a few' in fixed everyday phrases. It is still 两, never 二.
rules.pattern: 过 + 两 + 天;  这 + 两 + 天;  Verb + 两 + measure word

examples.py: guò liǎng tiān wǒ zài lái kàn nǐ
examples.en: I'll come and see you again in a couple of days.

examples.py: zhè liǎng tiān wǒ tè bié máng
examples.en: I've been really busy these last few days.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng shuō liǎng jù
examples.en: I'd like to say a few words.

rules.note: Context decides whether 两天 is exactly two days or just 'a few'; the grammar is the same.

rules.rule: 俩 = 两个. It goes after a plural pronoun or straight before a noun, and never takes another measure word.
rules.pattern: 我们 / 你们 / 他们 + 俩;  俩 + noun

examples.py: wǒ men liǎ shì tóng xué
examples.en: The two of us are classmates.

examples.py: tā men liǎ dōu xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú
examples.en: Both of them like playing basketball.

examples.py: nǐ men liǎng ge qù nǎ r
examples.en: Where are you two going?

rules.note: 俩 is informal and spoken. 我们两个 means the same and suits any style; 俩 is used for people and a few everyday nouns, not as a general replacement for 两 + measure.

right.py: wǒ yǒu liǎng ge gē ge

contrasts.why: A quantity before a measure word is 两. 二 does not stand directly before 个.

right.py: wǒ men liǎng diǎn jiàn ba

contrasts.why: Two o'clock is always 两点. 点 behaves like a measure word here.

right.py: wǒ xué le liǎng nián hàn yǔ
right.en: I have studied Chinese for two years.

contrasts.why: A length of time is an amount, so 两年. 二年 only appears in labels such as 二年级.

right.py: wǒ de shēng rì shì èr yuè wǔ hào
right.en: My birthday is the fifth of February.

contrasts.why: February is the second month, a label, so 二月. 两个月 means two months long.

right.py: zhè shì wǒ dì èr cì lái shàng hǎi
right.en: This is my second time in Shanghai.

contrasts.why: After 第 it is always 二, even with a measure word after it. 两次 without 第 means twice.

right.py: wǒ men bān yǒu shí èr ge xué sheng
right.en: There are twelve students in our class.

contrasts.why: Inside 十二 the 二 is part of the number, so the measure word after it changes nothing.

right.py: zhè běn shū èr shí kuài qián

contrasts.why: Before 十 only 二 is possible. 两 starts a number only before 百, 千, 万, 亿.

right.py: tā men liǎ dōu shì xué sheng
right.en: The two of them are both students.

contrasts.why: 俩 already means 两个, so adding 个 doubles the measure word. Say 他们俩 or 他们两个.

right.py: guò liǎng tiān wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
right.en: I'll call you in a couple of days.

contrasts.why: 'A couple of days' is still a quantity of days, so 两天.

right.en: I live on the second floor.

contrasts.why: A floor number is a label: 二楼. Two floors as an amount would be 两层.

cheat: Measure word right after a lone 'two'? 两: 两个, 两本, 两次, 两块.
Clock and durations: 两点, 两天, 两年, 两个月.
Could you say 'second' or 'number two'? 二: 第二, 二月, 二号, 二楼, 星期二.
Touching 十? Always 二: 十二个, 二十个, 二十二.
Front of a big number: 两千, 两万; 二百 or 两百 both work.
Bare number, digit, decimal or fraction: 二 (零点二, 二分之一).
俩 = 两个, so never 俩个; 我们俩 = 我们两个.
